data.animaCaption: Seated angled in the rain-pounded sedan backseat in her half-unzipped matte black leather jacket, she unrolls a clean white gauze bandage across her lap while glancing sideways at you in disguised worry. Cool blue rainy city lights through the side window contrast with the warm car dome lamp.
data.promptProse: Shot as a tight full-bleed close-up inside the dim leather backseat of a black sedan parked during a downpour, Shiki Natsume sits angled toward the viewer in a fitted cropped black leather jacket worn half-unzipped over a sleek dark top and fingerless gloves. Rain-damp black locks cling to her flushed cheek as her gloved hands unroll a clean white medical bandage on her lap, her golden eyes locked sideways onto you beneath a warm overhead dome lamp and cool blue rain streaks on the side glass.
data.story: 暴雨把整扇车窗敲得一片模糊，高架桥外的红蓝尾灯在车厢里明灭不定。夏目半拉开皮衣拉链倾身靠过来，露指手套利落地替你勒紧渗血的绷带，声音又冷又急——「再敢替我挡刀，下次我直接把你拷在安全屋里。」
